Regarding the X-Ray vision & other "Superman sex" issues:

  1. Superman's X-Ray vision isn't using X-Rays. That's just a name to explain the ability concisely, i.e. "he can see through things to see the things behind them". Superman is basically the ultimate telekinetic (create & perceive fields with your consciousness). He can perceive a sort-of field in the universe that humanity's science doesn't understand or know of yet. Density of objects is still a problem (thus, lead), but still, it's not X-Ray vision. You won't get cancer or become sterile. It doesn't work like that.

  2. Superman's powers didn't develop overnight. There are many stories in the comics explaining how he got to be as strong as he is and how Supergirl, taking a different path, ended up just as strong. Long story short: A baby not exposed to the Yellow Sun likely wouldn't have superpowers. And the same is likely true of Superman's sperm.

  3. What makes Superman invulnerable is what amounts to a telekinetic field around him. This is what allows him to pick up massive objects that should break apart when only held up by his hands (due to surface area to weight ratio). The field envelopes said thing (such as a cruise ship) and maintains it. He doesn't consciously control it generally, so that's why it's never brought up in the comics (that's the explanation anyway, this is largely a retcon on other explanations for how he does what he does).

There are logical issues with Kryptonian-Human relations, but I just wanted to point out the above things. That's as of I think 4-5 years ago. They may have done even more retcon explanations since, but the idea is that Superman is what amounts to a Telekinetic who doesn't act like one beyond empowering himself (i.e. he doesn't move cars & such with his mind, he's melee only generally).

Fellow comic geeks, feel free to correct me, but I believe this is the latest explanation for his powers and how they work.
